verdict.rationale: Representation by patent attorneys or other authorized agents is a fair question for an IP office, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only filing routes (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAdirektPro, paper, ePCT), accelerated examination, and register or search tools. None of it documents representatives, designees, authorized providers, or any sanctioned way for a third party to act for a company.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
